title: Sindh Teaching Promotion and Use of Sindhi Language Amendment Act 1991

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Teaching Promotion and Use of Sindhi Language Amendment Act 1991
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT VIII OF 1990
ACT VIII OF 1990
SINDH (TEACHING, PROMOTION AND USE OF SINDHI LANGUAGE) (AMENDMENT) ACT,
1991
An Act to further amend the Sindh (Teaching, Promotion and Use of
Sindhi Language) Act, 1972
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary, Part IV, 23rd December, 1990]
No. PAS/Lcgis-B-5/90, dated
23-12-1990.--The Sindh (Teaching, Promotion and Use of Sindhi Language)
(Amendment) Bill, 1990 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh
on 19th November, 1990 and assented to by the Governor of Sindh on 4th December,
1990 is hereby published as an Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
1. Short title and commencement.--(l) This Act may be called the
Sindh (Teaching, Promotion and Use of Sindhi Language) (Amendment) Act, 1990.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Teaching Promotion and Use of Sindhi Language Amendment Act 1991
sections.description:
Amendment of sections 5 and V of Sindh Act 2 of 1972

ACT VIII OF 1990
ACT VIII OF 1990
SINDH (TEACHING, PROMOTION AND USE OF SINDHI LANGUAGE) (AMENDMENT) ACT,
1991
An Act to further amend the Sindh (Teaching, Promotion and Use of
Sindhi Language) Act, 1972
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary, Part IV, 23rd December, 1990]
No. PAS/Lcgis-B-5/90, dated
23-12-1990.--The Sindh (Teaching, Promotion and Use of Sindhi Language)
(Amendment) Bill, 1990 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh
on 19th November, 1990 and assented to by the Governor of Sindh on 4th December,
1990 is hereby published as an Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
2. Amendment of sections 5 and V of Sindh Act 2 of 1972.--In the
Sindh (Teaching, Promotion and Use of Sindhi Language) Act, 1972, in section 5,
and in section 7, in subsection (2), in clause (b), for the words
"Academies and Boards" the words and comma "an Authority,
Academies or Boards" shall be substituted.
